<DIV align="left"><A NAME="Y90299004"></A></DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 12pt"><B>Item&nbsp;3. Incorporation of Documents by Reference.</B>
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;The following documents, which previously have been filed by Vale S.A. (&#147;<U>Vale</U>&#148;) with
the Securities and Exchange Commission (the &#147;<U>SEC</U>&#148;), are incorporated herein by reference and made a part hereof:
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;(a)&nbsp;Vale&#146;s Annual Report on Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December&nbsp;31, 2009, filed with
the SEC on April&nbsp;29, 2010 and amended on June&nbsp;15, 2010 (File No.&nbsp;001-15030);
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;(b)&nbsp;Vale&#146;s report on Form 6-K furnished to the SEC on February&nbsp;25, 2011 (File No.&nbsp;001-15030)
containing our audited consolidated financial statements as of December&nbsp;31, 2010 and 2009 and for
the years ended December&nbsp;31, 2010, 2009 and 2008; and all other reports filed by Vale pursuant to
Section 13(a) or 15(d) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the &#147;<U>Exchange
Act</U>&#148;) since December&nbsp;31, 2009; and
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;(c)&nbsp;The description of Vale&#146;s Preferred Class&nbsp;A shares contained in its annual report on Form
20-F for the fiscal year ended December&nbsp;31, 2009.
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;All reports and other documents filed by Vale pursuant to Sections&nbsp;13(a), 13(c), 14 or 15(d)
of the Exchange Act subsequent to the date of this Registration Statement and prior to the filing
of a post-effective amendment hereto indicating that all securities offered hereunder have been
sold or deregistering all securities remaining unsold, shall be deemed to be incorporated by
reference in this Registration Statement and to be a part hereof from the date of filing of such
documents.
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;For purposes of this Registration Statement, any document or any statement contained in a
document incorporated or deemed to be incorporated herein by reference shall be deemed to be
modified or superseded to the extent that a subsequently filed document or a statement contained
herein or in any other subsequently filed document which also is or is deemed to be incorporated
herein by reference modifies or supersedes such document or such statement in such document. Any
statement so modified or superseded shall not be deemed, except as so modified or superseded, to
constitute a part of this Registration Statement.

<DIV align="left"><A NAME="Y90299007"></A></DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 12pt"><B>Item&nbsp;6. Indemnification of Directors and Officers.</B>
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Neither the laws of Brazil nor Vale&#146;s bylaws or other constitutive documents provide for
indemnification of directors and officers. Under the Brazilian Civil Code, a person engaged in an
illegal
</DIV>

<P align="center" style="font-size: 10pt"><!-- Folio -->&nbsp;<!-- /Folio -->
</DIV>

<!-- PAGEBREAK -->
<P><HR noshade><P>
<H5 align="left" style="page-break-before:always"><A HREF="#Y90299toc">Table of Contents</A></H5><P>

<DIV style="font-family: 'Times New Roman',Times,serif">
<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">action must indemnify any third person that incurred losses or damages arising from such
illegal action. Vale maintains standard policies of insurance under which coverage is provided (a)
to its directors and officers against loss rising from claims made by reason of breach of duty or
other wrongful act, and (b)&nbsp;to Vale itself with respect to payments which may be made by Vale to
such officers and directors pursuant to the above indemnification provision or otherwise as a
matter of law.
</DIV>

<!-- link2 "Item&nbsp;9. Undertakings" -->
<DIV align="left"><A NAME="Y90299010"></A></DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 12pt"><B>Item&nbsp;9. Undertakings.</B>
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;(a)&nbsp;Vale hereby undertakes:
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt; margin-left: 4%">(1)&nbsp;To file, during any period in which offers or sales are being made, a
post-effective amendment to this Registration Statement:
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt; margin-left: 6%">(i)&nbsp;To include any prospectus required by Section&nbsp;10(a)(3) of the Securities
Act;
</DIV>

<P align="center" style="font-size: 10pt"><!-- Folio -->&nbsp;<!-- /Folio -->
</DIV>

<!-- PAGEBREAK -->
<P><HR noshade><P>
<H5 align="left" style="page-break-before:always"><A HREF="#Y90299toc">Table of Contents</A></H5><P>

<DIV style="font-family: 'Times New Roman',Times,serif">




<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt; margin-left: 6%">(ii)&nbsp;To reflect in the prospectus any facts or events arising after the
effective date of the Registration Statement (or the most recent
post-effective amendment thereof) which, individually or in the aggregate,
represent a fundamental change in the information set forth in the
Registration Statement;
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt; margin-left: 6%">(iii)&nbsp;To include any material information with respect to the plan of
distribution not previously disclosed in the Registration Statement or any
material change to such information in the Registration Statement;
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">provided, however, that paragraphs (a)(1)(i) and (a)(1)(ii) do not apply if the information
required to be included in a post-effective amendment by those paragraphs is contained in periodic
reports filed with or furnished to the SEC by Vale pursuant to Section&nbsp;13 or 15(d) of the
Exchange Act that are incorporated by reference in the Registration Statement.
</DIV>



<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt; margin-left: 4%">(2)&nbsp;That, for the purpose of determining any liability under the Securities Act,
each such post-effective amendment shall be deemed to be a new registration
statement relating to the securities offered therein, and the offering of such
securities at that time shall be deemed to be the initial <I>bona fide </I>offering
thereof.
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt; margin-left: 4%">(3)&nbsp;To remove from registration by means of a post-effective amendment any of the
securities being registered which remain unsold at the termination of the offering.
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt; margin-left: 2%">(b)&nbsp;Vale hereby undertakes that, for purposes of determining any liability under the
Securities Act, each filing of Vale&#146;s annual report pursuant to Section 13(a) or 15(d) of
the Exchange Act (and, where applicable, each filing of the employee benefit plan&#146;s annual
report pursuant to Section 15(d) of the Exchange Act) that is incorporated by reference in
the Registration Statement shall be deemed to be a new registration statement relating to
the securities offered therein, and the offering of such securities at that time shall be
deemed to be the initial <I>bona fide </I>offering thereof.
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt; margin-left: 2%">(c)&nbsp;Insofar as indemnification for liabilities arising under the Securities Act may be
permitted to directors, officers and controlling persons of Vale pursuant to the foregoing
provisions, or otherwise, Vale has been advised that in the opinion of the SEC such
indemnification is against public policy as expressed in the Securities Act and is,
therefore, unenforceable. In the event that a claim for indemnification against such
liabilities (other than the payment by Vale of expenses incurred or paid by a director,
officer or controlling person of Vale in the successful defense of any action, suit or
proceeding) is asserted by such director, officer or controlling person in connection with
the securities being registered, Vale will, unless in the opinion of its counsel the matter
has been settled by controlling precedent, submit to a court of appropriate jurisdiction the
question whether such indemnification by it is against public policy as expressed in the
Securities Act and will be governed by the final adjudication of such issue.
</DIV>

<!-- PAGEBREAK -->
<DIV style="font-family: Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif">


<DIV align="right" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 12pt"><B>Exhibit&nbsp;4.3</B>
</DIV>


<DIV align="right" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 12pt"><IMG src="y90299y9029911.gif" alt="(VALE LOGO)">
</DIV>


<DIV align="center" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 18pt"><B>Matching Program</B>
</DIV>


<DIV align="Center" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">2011 Cycle<BR>
<I>Rewarding the Sustainable Performance</I>
</DIV>

<DIV align="Center" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt"><B>March&nbsp;2011</B>
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 12pt"><B>This document constitutes part of a prospectus covering securities that have been
registered under the Securities Act of 1933.</B>
</DIV>

<P>
<DIV style="width: 100%; border: 1px solid black; padding: 11px;">


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt"><B>Important Notice: </B>Participation in this program is completely optional for all eligible
employees. Participants are advised that the purchase of publicly traded shares is a
speculative investment that is subject to several risks such as capital market volatility,
share liquidity and oscillation of the share price. These risks may result in investment
losses. Vale does not represent or warranty the security of any share purchases made by
eligible employees through this program.
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">The purchase of shares through this program, matching rewards and/or disposition of such
shares may have tax consequences, including capital gains and losses, for a participant.
Please note that the tax treatment of capital gains or losses on shares purchased and/or
awarded through this program is dynamic due to the personal financial circumstances of a
participant and the taxation rules of the applicable jurisdiction, which may change from
time to time. Accordingly, the Human Resources Centers will endeavour to provide generic and
non-exhaustive information on the tax consequences of participation in this program, but all
participants shall be responsible for evaluating their own specific individual financial
situation, as well as consulting their own tax expert or other independent professional
advisor when electing to participate in this program.
</DIV>

</DIV>



<P align="center" style="font-size: 10pt"><!-- Folio -->&nbsp;<!-- /Folio -->
</DIV>

<!-- PAGEBREAK -->
<P><HR noshade><P>
<H5 align="left" style="page-break-before:always">&nbsp;</H5><P>

<DIV style="font-family: Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif">

<P><HR noshade><P>
<H5 align="left" style="page-break-before:always">&nbsp;</H5><P>

<DIV style="font-family: Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif">


<DIV align="right" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 12pt"><IMG src="y90299y9029912.gif" alt="(VALE LOGO)">
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 12pt"><B>I. Purpose</B>
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">The purpose of Vale&#146;s Matching Program is to establish a reward mechanism for employees with a view
to:
</DIV>


<DIV style="margin-top: 6pt">
<TABLE width="100%" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font-size: 10pt">

<TR valign="top" style="font-size: 10pt; color: #000000; background: transparent">
    <TD width="2%" style="background: transparent">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD width="3%" nowrap align="left"><FONT style="font-family: Wingdings">&#167;</FONT></TD>
    <TD width="1%">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD> Encouraging employee &#147;ownership&#148;;</TD>
</TR>

<TR>
    <TD style="font-size: 6pt">&nbsp;</TD>
</TR><TR valign="top" style="font-size: 10pt; color: #000000; background: transparent">
    <TD width="2%" style="background: transparent">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD width="3%" nowrap align="left"><FONT style="font-family: Wingdings">&#167;</FONT></TD>
    <TD width="1%">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD> Raising attraction and retention capacity of Employees by Vale;</TD>
</TR>

<TR>
    <TD style="font-size: 6pt">&nbsp;</TD>
</TR><TR valign="top" style="font-size: 10pt; color: #000000; background: transparent">
    <TD width="2%" style="background: transparent">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD width="3%" nowrap align="left"><FONT style="font-family: Wingdings">&#167;</FONT></TD>
    <TD width="1%">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD>Reinforcing the sustainable performance culture.</TD>
</TR>

</TABLE>
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 12pt"><B>General Information</B>
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">The following rules are exclusively valid for the 2011 Matching Program cycle; Entitlement
to stock matching awards under this program shall be based on the employee&#146;s performance in
2010.
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">The 2011 Matching Program term shall commence on April 4<SUP style="FONT-size: 85%; vertical-align: text-top">th</SUP>, 2011 and end on
April 3<SUP style="FONT-size: 85%; vertical-align: text-top">rd</SUP>, 2014.
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">The implementation of the 2011 Matching Program is a one-time discretionary benefit and Vale
reserves its right to unilaterally alter, amend, change or modify the formula utilized to
calculate the matching benefit awards, or to eliminate the Matching Program benefit, in
whole or in part, at any time in subsequent years, with or without prior notice.
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">For greater clarity, employee&#146;s participation in the 2011 Matching Program shall not
generate an expectation of future entitlement, as Vale is not obliged to implement the
Matching Program in the years to come.
</DIV>



<P align="center" style="font-size: 10pt"><!-- Folio -->2<!-- /Folio -->
</DIV>

<H5 align="left" style="page-break-before:always">&nbsp;</H5><P>

<DIV style="font-family: Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif">






<DIV align="right" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 12pt"><IMG src="y90299y9029912.gif" alt="(VALE LOGO)">
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 12pt"><B>III. Matching</B>
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">Employees eligible to participate in the Program may acquire Vale preferred shares,
according to the criteria defined below, and shall be entitled, at the expiry of the term of
the program, to a reward that matches on a one to one basis (1:1) the number of shares
purchased by the Employee, <u>provided that such shares are owned and retained in whole by the
Employee for the entirety of term of the Matching Program</u>.
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 12pt"><B>a) Acquisition Criteria of Shares</B>
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">Participation in the program is completely optional and will be based on employees&#146; position in the
quadrants as per the Career &#038; Succession matrix:
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 12pt"><B>Participation Options</B>
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">(% of net amount received as short-term incentive &#151; AIP- award payable for 2010 to acquire Vale
shares)
</DIV>

<DIV align="center">
<TABLE style="font-size: 10pt" cellspacing="0" border="0" cellpadding="0" width="100%">
<!-- Begin Table Head -->
<TR valign="bottom">
    <TD width="2%">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD width="1%">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD width="2%">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD width="1%">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD width="47%">&nbsp;</TD>
</TR>
<TR></TR>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 12pt"><B>b) Acquisition of Shares</B>
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">Vale is responsible for the definition and contracting of the brokerage firm that shall perform the
opening of accounts, purchases and custody of shares and monitoring the balances of the employees
until the end of the cycle. In addition to that, the Company shall also undertake, at the
contracted brokerage firms, the expenses related to these provided services <u>during the cycle</u>.
</DIV>


<DIV style="margin-top: 6pt">
<TABLE width="100%" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font-size: 10pt">

firm in Brazil will acquire the shares (VALE5) at BM&#038;FBOVESPA and monitor the accounts.</TD>

    <TD style="font-size: 6pt">&nbsp;</TD>

Brazil, a brokerage firm in USA will acquire the ADR&#146;s (American Depositary Receipt) of

transferred to other countries, if the largest part of the AIP is paid in Brazil, the

Brazil, the brokerage firm in USA will be used.</TD>
</TR>

</DIV>
<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">To purchase the shares and to be entitled to the Program, the Employee shall provide the
documentation required to open the account to the brokerage firm, according to the
established schedule contained in this document. Once the account is opened and the funds
received, the brokerage firm shall perform the acquisition of shares at market prices on
April 4<SUP style="FONT-size: 85%; vertical-align: text-top">th</SUP>.

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 12pt"><B>d) Matching of Shares</B>
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">During the term of the Matching Program, participating Employees have the right to sell all
or part of the shares purchased through this program.. The Employee shall forfeit the right
to the share Matching reward offered by Vale on all shares sold prior to the expiry of the
term of the program, being April 3rd, 2014, and shall also be responsible for <U>any costs
arising from such sale</U>.
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">At the end of the cycle, that is, three years after the acquisition of shares, Vale shall
check the Employees&#146; balances with the brokerage firms. Those who have not sold any of the
acquired shares in the beginning of the cycle shall be eligible to the Matching reward
receipt.
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt"><B>Example: </B>Employee eligible to have 30% or 50% of the net value of its short-term incentive
(AIP).
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 12pt"><B>Moment I (cycle starts)</B>
</DIV>


<DIV style="margin-top: 6pt">

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 12pt"><B>e) Special Conditions</B>
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt"><B>I. Termination of Employment</B>

</DIV>
<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">The conditions below define what shall happen in the case of the following employment related
events:
</DIV>


<DIV style="margin-top: 6pt">
<TABLE width="100%" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font-size: 10pt">

<TR valign="top" style="font-size: 10pt; color: #000000; background: transparent">
    <TD width="2%" style="background: transparent">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD width="3%" nowrap align="left"><FONT style="font-family: Wingdings">&#167;</FONT></TD>
    <TD width="1%">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD><U>Resignation</U>: An Employee shall not be eligible to the Matching reward if he or she
resigns his or her employment and such resignation is effective during the term of the Matching
Program. However, the Employee may sell or keep the shares that were
acquired with his/her funds. Administration costs of the fund, where applicable, will be the
responsibility of the individual as of the effective date of resignation.</TD>
</TR>

<TR>
    <TD style="font-size: 6pt">&nbsp;</TD>
</TR><TR valign="top" style="font-size: 10pt; color: #000000; background: transparent">
    <TD width="2%" style="background: transparent">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD width="3%" nowrap align="left"><FONT style="font-family: Wingdings">&#167;</FONT></TD>

    <TD width="1%">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD> <U>Dismissal by Vale (Without Cause)</U>: An employee dismissed
without just cause during the term of the Matching Program may sell or keep the shares
acquired with his/her own funds and the Matching reward entitlement shall be prorated for
the period of time from the commencement of the Matching Program cycle. Administration
costs of the fund, where applicable, will be the responsibility of the individual as of
the resignation date.</TD>
</TR>

<TR>
    <TD style="font-size: 6pt">&nbsp;</TD>
</TR><TR valign="top" style="font-size: 10pt; color: #000000; background: transparent">
    <TD width="2%" style="background: transparent">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD width="3%" nowrap align="left"><FONT style="font-family: Wingdings">&#167;</FONT></TD>

    <TD width="1%">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD><U>Dismissal by Vale (For Cause)</U>: An employee dismissed for just
cause during the term of the Matching Program may sell or keep the shares acquired with
his/her own funds, but shall not be entitled to any Matching reward from Vale.
Administration costs of the fund, where applicable, will be the responsibility of the
individual as of the date of termination.</TD>
</TR>

<TR>
    <TD style="font-size: 6pt">&nbsp;</TD>
</TR><TR valign="top" style="font-size: 10pt; color: #000000; background: transparent">
    <TD width="2%" style="background: transparent">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD width="3%" nowrap align="left"><FONT style="font-family: Wingdings">&#167;</FONT></TD>

    <TD width="1%">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD><U>Death or permanent disability</U>: In the event of death or the
employee becoming permanently disabled during the term of the Matching Program, the
employee or his/her legal heirs may sell or keep the shares acquired with his/her own
funds and shall receive the full Matching reward value upon death/disability date.
Administration costs of the fund, where applicable, will be the responsibility of the
individual as of the date of death or permanent disability.</TD>
</TR>

<TR>
    <TD style="font-size: 6pt">&nbsp;</TD>
</TR><TR valign="top" style="font-size: 10pt; color: #000000; background: transparent">
    <TD width="2%" style="background: transparent">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD width="3%" nowrap align="left"><FONT style="font-family: Wingdings">&#167;</FONT></TD>

    <TD width="1%">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD><U>Change of Control</U>: An employee dismissed without just cause
following a Change of Control event may sell or keep the shares acquired with his/her own
funds and the Matching reward entitlement shall be prorated for the number of months
he/she participated in the Matching Program, to the date that the Change of Control
occurs. Administration costs of the fund, where
</TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
</DIV>
<P align="center" style="font-size: 10pt"><!-- Folio -->7<!-- /Folio -->
</DIV>

    <TD width="2%" style="background: transparent">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD width="3%" nowrap align="left">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD width="1%">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD>applicable, will be the responsibility of the individual as of the date that the Change of

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 12pt"><B>IV. Timetable</B>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">In order to be eligible to participate in the Program, the employee shall observe the schedule below.

</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 12pt"><B>Summary:</B>
</DIV>

<DIV align="center">
<TABLE style="font-size: 10pt" cellspacing="0" border="0" cellpadding="0" width="100%">

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 12pt"><B>a) Enrollment to the Program and Opening of Account</B>
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">The enrollment to the Program assumes the forwarding of the &#147;Enrollment Form&#148; (totally
filled in and signed) and the documents necessary to open the account. In the Enrollment
Form, the Employee shall opt for the percentage applicable to its reward range.
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">If the Employee has participated in the last Matching cycle and already has an account for
this purpose in the brokerage defined by Vale and if for this cycle he is still eligible to
use the same brokerage, it will not be necessary to open a new account.
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">For those who do not meet the condition described above, please refer to the
documents below:
</DIV>


<DIV style="margin-top: 6pt">
<TABLE width="100%" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font-size: 10pt">

<TR valign="top" style="font-size: 10pt; color: #000000; background: transparent">
    <TD width="2%" style="background: transparent">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD width="3%" nowrap align="left">1.</TD>
    <TD width="1%">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD>Employees receiving short-term incentive (AIP)&nbsp;award <B>in Brazil </B>shall
fill in the form of the brokerage firm in Brazil. Along with the completed form,
the Employee shall send, <U>to its Human Resources Representative</U>, a copy
of the following documents: ID card, CPF (Individual Taxpayer&#146;s Roll) and proof
of residence. Doubts related to the brokerage form and documentation can be
sorted out through your local HR.</TD>
</TR>

<TR>
    <TD style="font-size: 6pt">&nbsp;</TD>
</TR><TR valign="top" style="font-size: 10pt; color: #000000; background: transparent">
    <TD width="2%" style="background: transparent">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD width="3%" nowrap align="left">2.</TD>
    <TD width="1%">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD>Employees receiving short-term incentive (AIP)&nbsp;award outside Brazil
(including those on international assignments) shall fill in and send</TD>
</TR>


</TABLE>
</DIV>

</DIV>

</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 12pt"><B>b) Wire of Funds to Shares Acquisition</B>
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">After the enrollment, each employee shall transfer the funds according to his/her investment
option, into a bank account designated by Vale, in each country. The funds will be remitted
by wire transfer directed by Vale to the brokerage firms for the shares acquisition
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 12pt"><B>c) Acquisition of Shares</B>
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt"><U>Date of Shares Acquisition:</U> April 4<SUP style="FONT-size: 85%; vertical-align: text-top">th</SUP>2011.
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">On the determined date, the brokerage firms shall purchase, <u>at market value</u>, the shares
related to the Employees&#146; investment. The number of shares shall be allocated to each
participant proportionally to their investment by the average acquisition price of the whole
shares.
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">As soon as the shares have been purchased, the Employees will receive from the brokerage a
communication: share price of the purchase, shares balance, site address, login and password
(for online consultation).
</DIV>




<P align="center" style="font-size: 10pt"><!-- Folio -->10<!-- /Folio -->
</DIV>

<!-- PAGEBREAK -->
<P><HR noshade><P>
<H5 align="left" style="page-break-before:always">&nbsp;</H5><P>

<DIV style="font-family: Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif">




<DIV align="right" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 12pt"><IMG src="y90299y9029912.gif" alt="(VALE LOGO)">
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 12pt"><B>V. Questions &#038; Answers</B>
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt"><B>1. Who shall I contact to perform the purchase of shares and which documents shall be
necessary to carry out this operation?</B>
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">You shall contact your Local Human Resources Representative that is responsible for
intermediating the opening of your account at the brokerage firm identified for your
situation.
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt"><B>2. The percentage used for the purchase of shares shall be calculated on the
net or gross amount of the short-term incentive (AIP)&nbsp;referent to 2010?</B>
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">The percentage to be used by the Employee for the purchase of shares shall be calculated <u>on
the net amount</u> of the short-term incentive (AIP)&nbsp;award referent to 2010.
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt"><B>3. If I am promoted before or after the purchase of shares, what shall happen?</B>
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">The positions occupied on December&nbsp;31<SUP style="FONT-size: 85%; vertical-align: text-top">st</SUP> 2010 shall be used as reference. Thus,
promotions and admissions after such date shall not have effect on the reward program.
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt"><B>4. Which are the starting and end dates of the Matching cycle?</B>
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">The 2011 cycle starts on April 4<SUP style="FONT-size: 85%; vertical-align: text-top">th </SUP>, 2011 and ends on April 3<SUP style="FONT-size: 85%; vertical-align: text-top">rd</SUP> , 2014.
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt"><B>5. If I resign during the cycle, what shall my entitlement be?</B>
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">If the Employee resigns from Vale voluntarily, he/she may sell or keep the shares that were
acquired with his/her own funds, but shall not be eligible for any Matching reward. After
resignation, the employee shall be responsible for any costs he/she may incur in the
administration and or disposition of the shares by the broker, if any.
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt"><B>6. If I am terminated during the cycle, what shall my entitlement be?</B>
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">The Employee terminated without just cause may sell or keep the shares acquired with its own
funds and shall receive the prorated Matching value, according to the Program rules, based
on the number of months he/she participated in the Matching
</DIV>




<P align="center" style="font-size: 10pt"><!-- Folio -->11<!-- /Folio -->
</DIV>

<!-- PAGEBREAK -->
<P><HR noshade><P>
<H5 align="left" style="page-break-before:always">&nbsp;</H5><P>

<DIV style="font-family: Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif">




<DIV align="right" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 12pt"><IMG src="y90299y9029912.gif" alt="(VALE LOGO)">
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">Program up to the termination date. A terminated employee shall be responsible for any costs
he/she may incur in the administration and or disposition of the shares by the broker, if
any.
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt"><B>7. Shall I receive the Matching in cash or shares?</B>
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">Vale will determine the form of payment at the time of payout at its discretion. However,
the total payment at the time the matching is due, will be equivalent to the amount of
shares initially purchased in the program.
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt"><B>8. Can I purchase more shares with the amount that I shall receive as dividends and/or
interests?</B>
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">Each brokerage has a different process, enabling purchase preferred shares with the amount
received as dividends or making a deposit in the specified bank account. However, this
<U>shall not be considered for the Matching Program</U>.
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt"><B>9. Can I acquire additional shares in the account opened for the Matching?</B>
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">No.&nbsp;Only automatic investments made with amounts received as dividends and/or interests
shall be performed. <U>The Matching account shall be blocked for other shares
acquisitions</U>.
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt"><B>10. In case of deployment/split of shares, how will the Matching be
calculated?</B>
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">In case of share deployment/split, the number of shares to be received shall also
be adjusted in order to reflect the eventual deployment/split.
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt"><B>11. If the amount sent to the brokerage cannot buy a whole number of shares,
what should happen?</B>
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">For the Employees that acquire shares at BM&#038;FBOVESPA, the brokerage in Brazil will purchase
the largest number of whole shares and the remaining funds shall be wired to the Employee
bank account as informed in the opening account form. For the Employees that acquire shares
at NYSE, the brokerage in USA has a procedure that allows the purchase of a factionary
number of shares, therefore, no remaining funds will be returned.
</DIV>




<P align="center" style="font-size: 10pt"><!-- Folio -->12<!-- /Folio -->
</DIV>

<!-- PAGEBREAK -->
<P><HR noshade><P>
<H5 align="left" style="page-break-before:always">&nbsp;</H5><P>

<DIV style="font-family: Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif">




<DIV align="right" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 12pt"><IMG src="y90299y9029912.gif" alt="(VALE LOGO)">
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt"><B>Example:</B>

</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">a) Employee that has acquired shares at BM&#038;FBOVESPA.<BR>
Funds remitted = $50,020.00<BR>
<U>Hypothetical</U> share price = $25.00<BR>
Number of shares purchased = 2,000<BR>
Remaining funds to be wired to the Employee&#146;s bank account = $20.00

</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">b) Employee that has acquired Vale ADR&#146;s at NYSE.<BR>
Funds remitted = $25,020.00<BR>
<U>Hypothetical</U> share price = $12.50<BR>
Number of shares purchased = 2,001.60

</DIV>
<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt"><B>12. And if I sell all or part of the shares before the cycle ends?</B>
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">This reward was designed with the purpose of promoting ownership and vision among Vale
Employees. Thus, the Company expects from participants, a shareowner attitude (that is, from
that who shall have share ownership for a certain period for believing in the Company growth
capacity) and not only a shareholder one (that is, that who temporarily owns the share,
until it finds the adequate moment to sell it). For such reason, if you sell all or part of
the shares acquired prior to the end of the cycle, you shall not receive any Matching reward
amount, and any costs arising from the sale or custody by the broker of such shares shall be
the sole responsibility of the Employee.
</DIV>




<P align="center" style="font-size: 10pt"><!-- Folio -->13<!-- /Folio -->
</DIV>

</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 12pt"><B>VI. Glossary</B>
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt"><U>Employees</U>: Vale employees or subsidiaries approved (Appendix), who fill the positions
eligible to participate in this program
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt"><U>Matching Cycle</U>: The 2011 cycle starts on March 1<SUP style="FONT-size: 85%; vertical-align: text-top">st</SUP>, 2011 and ends 36&nbsp;months
after.
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt"><U>Brokerage Firm:</U> Firm that shall perform the opening of the account, share custody and
purchase and monitoring of the Employees&#146; balance.
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt"><U>Short-term incentive (AIP &#151; Annual Incentive Plan):</U> Company Program, from which its
employees receive, according to the performance combination of the Company, of the
Department and Individual, an amount as participation in the Company profits referent to the
year considered as time interval for the performance evaluations.
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt"><U>Matching Management Committee:</U> Committee composed by the CFO and the HR and
Corporate Services Officer. This committee is responsible for the decision-making related to
the Matching reward program in situations not covered in this document.
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt"><U>BM&#038;FBOVESPA</U>: S&#227;o Paulo Stock Exchange (<U>www.bmfBM&#038;FBOVESPA.com.br</U>).
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt"><U>NYSE</U>: New York Stock Exchange (<U>www.nyse.com</U>).
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt"><U>ADR&#146;s (American Depositary Receipt)</U>: They represent the ownership of shares from
foreign companies negotiated in the US financial market. ADR&#146;s allow to foreign investors
residing in the US the purchase of shares from foreign companies without remitting funds
abroad. ADR&#146;s have their value determined by the US dollar; their dividends are paid through
the same currency and can be negotiated as US companies shares.
</DIV>




<P align="center" style="font-size: 10pt"><!-- Folio -->14<!-- /Folio -->
</DIV>

<!-- PAGEBREAK -->
<P><HR noshade><P>
<H5 align="left" style="page-break-before:always">&nbsp;</H5><P>

<DIV style="font-family: Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif">




<DIV align="right" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 12pt"><IMG src="y90299y9029912.gif" alt="(VALE LOGO)">
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt"><U>Career and Succession Matrix:</U> Tool used by Vale to classify its employees according
to the evaluation of the latter regarding the performance and competences observed
throughout one year.
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt"><U>Dividends:</U> They are payments made by the companies to the owners of their shares.
When a company obtains profits, these can be managed mainly by two manners: reinvested in
the own company (also called retained earnings) or paid to the shareholders as dividends.
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt"><U>Interests:</U> It is a remuneration system to the shareholder alternative to the payment
of dividends. The difference lays on the tax effect of this measure, which is entitled to
some deductibility for the company in the calculation of its income tax.
</DIV>




<P align="center" style="font-size: 10pt"><!-- Folio -->15<!-- /Folio -->
</DIV>
